name: Sharifa Rukhshana
original_name: シャリファ・ルクサーナ
source:
Hobbies: Chatting about love, lewd stories
Skills: Attracting boys with her bombshell body
Weakness: [url=/c42540]Mao[/url] (her rival)

A third-year student, the former student council president of west tower before [url=/c40213]Iris[/url] and a foreign exchange student from Malaysia. Her magic type is considered very rare in the magic world: she is able to use her magic to create all kinds of creatures. Her potential is so high that she is considered a genius in the magicians' world.

An extremely popular girl who however, wears her school uniform in a very revealing way and is almost always talking dirty. She likes messing around with boys and dancing around as well. She has high expectations for [url=/c40213]Iris[/url] because of the crushing defeat which made her see Mao as her rival, and wants to have revenge on her.
